# Piedmont Triad Equity Solutions — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Piedmont Triad Equity Solutions is a nationwide surplus fund recovery firm based in North Carolina that helps former property owners identify and reclaim funds left over after foreclosures, tax sales, and public auctions. The brand positions itself around trust, transparency, and zero financial risk to the client — operating on a contingency basis where they only get paid upon successful recovery. The firm emphasizes confidentiality, a step-by-step guided process, and a dedicated recovery specialist for every claim, projecting a professional yet approachable tone aimed at individuals who may be unaware they are owed money.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Piedmont Triad Equity Solutions
Piedmont Triad Equity Solutions is a nationwide surplus fund recovery firm based in North Carolina that helps former property owners identify and reclaim funds left over after foreclosures, tax sales, and public auctions. The brand positions itself around trust, transparency, and zero financial risk to the client — operating on a contingency basis where they only get paid upon successful recovery. The firm emphasizes confidentiality, a step-by-step guided process, and a dedicated recovery specialist for every claim, projecting a professional yet approachable tone aimed at individuals who may be unaware they are owed money.

## Target Audience
- Former property owners or related parties who may be owed surplus funds from foreclosure, tax sale, or public auction proceedings
- Former Property Owners
- Heirs of Deceased Owners
- Real Estate Investors

## Industry
Financial Recovery Services
